name: Short-Stay Visa (Type C)

requirements.blocker_text: Travel must fall under one of Moldova's short-stay visa subcategories (C/T tourism, C/V private visit, C/A business, C/TS transport, C/S sport, C/AD cultural/scientific/humanitarian/medical).
Subsistence proof of roughly EUR 30/day (minimum EUR 300 for stays under 10 days) and travel medical insurance of at least EUR 30,000 coverage.

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within a 180-day period; many nationalities are visa-exempt for the same duration

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Moldova -- types of visas and requirements: short-stay Type C subcategories, EUR 30/day subsistence proof (min EUR 300 for stays under 10 days), EUR 30,000 travel medical insurance, EUR 40 consular fee
